_about: fonterra.com — 'Project New Dawn' component set; site overrides on top of fonterra-shared-block-mapping.json (evidence: dump-variants + review-sheet.jpg). nz/en rendered in full, other 10 locales stratified-sampled. Components that render an empty <div> in publish (inPageLink, ghost, youTube, profileBadge, storyIndex, featuredArticle, tabbedContent, herotext) are client-side/placeholder wrappers.

newDawnImageTextWrapper.rationale: Image beside heading + copy (newDawnImageTextBadge, 1,501 instances) → Columns.

newDawnDownloadFile.rationale: File label (PDF chip + title) with a Download button (608 instances, investor/report pages) → default-content link list / button; keep file-type icon via styling.

cardtile.rationale: Image card with heading, copy and 'Learn more' (img-cards) → Cards.

cardTileContainer.rationale: Container of cardtiles → one Cards block.

ctabutton.rationale: Button link (bordered / link styles) → default-content button.

biography.rationale: Bio tiles (portrait/landscape photo, name, 'Read more +') → Cards (profile variant).

statistics.rationale: Statistic / contact tiles (heading + lines of text, newDawnStatistics) → Cards (text variant).

bannerAndBadge.rationale: Full-width image with an overlaid content badge (heading, copy, CTA; reverse / desktop-image modifiers) → Hero (badge variant).

featurePromos.rationale: Promo cards overlaid on a background image ('Behind the numbers', 'Farm Source' …) → Cards (overlay variant) in a section with background image.

video-component.rationale: Background/inline <video> with heading, copy, CTA → Video (or Hero with video background).

tabbedContentSnapshot.rationale: Year tabs (role=tabpanel) of report link lists → Tabs.

inPageNav.rationale: 'On this page' sticky section navigation (sectionNavigation) with scroll-spy → small custom block.

cardCarousel.rationale: 'Featured videos' / card slider (layout variants, CTA optional) → Carousel of cards.

photoCarousel.rationale: Photo slider with thumbnails (listbox/option) and captions → Carousel.

sectionNavigator.rationale: Linked section tiles with images → Cards.

relatedStories.rationale: 'Related stories' rail on 1,287 pages: article cards with category chip, date, read time and tag chips selected by page tags at runtime (fonterraRelatedStories list) → query-index driven related-articles block.

articleList.rationale: Newsroom/story listing with collapsible facet filters (checkbox groups), featured 'Media resources' tile and 'Load more' → query-index listing block with filters.

miniArticleListing.rationale: Compact news listing with category buttons → query-index listing block (mini variant).

articleCategoryIndex.rationale: Category index slider of articles (listbox) → query-index listing block (category variant).

topicIndex.rationale: Topic link index (listbox of topics, scroll buttons) → part of the article-listing / topic navigation.

editorialArticleScroller.rationale: 'Love from the farm' editorial mosaic: feature article beside a scrolling masonry of article tiles → bespoke layout + query-driven content.

flippingCard.rationale: Myth/fact flipping cards (click to flip front/back) → custom flip-cards block.

flippingCardTile.rationale: Individual flip card (front image/statement, back answer) → part of the flip-cards block.

milkDrop.rationale: Lottie (lottie-player) milk-drop scroll animation used as a section divider on 9 storytelling pages (169 instances) → custom animation block (load Lottie via delayed.js).

videoScroller.rationale: Scroll-driven video storytelling: sticky video whose chapters/captions advance on scroll (cmp-videoScroll, fadeUp) → custom block.

videoOverlayCarousel.rationale: '10+ Essential Nutrients' interactive explorer: nutrient list (listbox) driving an overlaid video/visual and benefit copy → custom block.

pillarExplorer.rationale: Strategy pillars as selectable image tiles (listbox/option) with copy and links → Carousel / Cards with a selected-state variant.

roadshow.rationale: Google Map with location markers + region table (roadshow-map, 23 instances) → custom interactive-map block (Maps API integration).

roadmapTimeline.rationale: Horizontal milestone timeline from a content-fragment list ('Our journey to phase out coal') with prev/next → custom timeline block fed by content fragments.

numbersDashboard.rationale: Investor 'numbers' dashboard: dynamic tiles + live share-price panel → custom block with a share-price data feed.

numbersDashboardTile.rationale: Metric tile of the numbers dashboard → part of the custom block.

numbersDashboardSharePrices.rationale: Tabbed live share prices (NZX/ASX) → part of the numbers-dashboard block (data feed).

quoteTable.rationale: Current share prices table fed by a market-data source → custom block (data feed); static fallback could be a Table.

newDawnInvestorsGraph.rationale: Interactive investor chart with selectable series/ranges (aria-expanded controls, region panels) → custom charting block.

integratedReport.rationale: Annual integrated-report explorer (icon list of report sections with downloads) → custom block.

swiftypesearchresults.rationale: Swiftype site search (query form, facet buttons, result list) — third-party search service → custom search block (or replace with the EDS query-index Search).

avatureCareersSearch.rationale: Avature careers job search (keyword + location/category filters) posting to the Avature ATS → custom block integrating Avature.

contactus-v3.rationale: Contact page: subject selector driving FAQ accordions and an enquiry form per subject (11 locales) → custom form block + backend integration.

inPageLink.rationale: In-page anchor link placeholder (empty in publish) → not migrated.

profileBadge.rationale: Author/profile badge placeholder (empty in publish) → page metadata / default content.

storyIndex.rationale: Story index rendered client-side (empty in server markup) → query-index listing block.

featuredArticle.rationale: Featured article placeholder filled client-side → featured variant of the article-listing block.
